notes: The placement gate stayed at 2000 ms. Preparation-to-engine-ready timing accounts for most cold latency difference; the runs do not isolate its cause.
The first burst status is read immediately after submission. The diagnostic run caught a queued dispatch inside the gate; the earlier run caught an empty eligible queue.
Scale In retains a fully admitted revision at the merged head. The rehearsal no longer builds an extra Managed Tunnel Worker revision on re-enable.
The stable checkpoint set does not include the extra read-only replacement submission and settlement probes.

setup_dispositions.remedy: verified Buildx binary in a private Docker config
read-only system CA mount, verified with networking disabled
use the SHA-256-verified local Pyodide bundle and explicit workerd cache flag; verified with a Python request and networking disabled
setup_dispositions.verification_note: An early cache miss attempted external asset TLS and failed before a bundle HTTP request. The recorded qualifying runs loaded the verified bundle from disk with the provider on an internal network.

setup_dispositions.remedy: read Docker-assigned provider address and keep the provider on the internal bridge

failure_dispositions.failure: A 1399 MiB saturator was still unassigned after 14 seconds with a live, unpressured 1423 MiB primary.
failure_dispositions.diagnostic: At the same transition a 128 MiB platform runner hold blocked the initial normal-lane claim. Ownership fencing succeeded and the subsequent claim used the restored budget. Terminal job state can precede the runner releasing its hold. The idle claim loop has a 15-second sweep that also exceeds the 14-second fixture window if a release lands during selection.
failure_dispositions.correction: Observe an idle, unpressured primary with a live lease before dispatching the near-full-memory fixture. The 14-second post-submission requirement remains.
failure_dispositions.historical_limit: The first failed run only recorded the final worker snapshot. The 128 MiB reservation was observed in the diagnostic control at the same precondition, and its release enabled the claim. The exact scheduling of the interrupted first run cannot be reconstructed.

failure_dispositions.failure: The live original dispatch passed the hold, then failed the Upgrade receipt cardinality check before Upgrade was submitted.
failure_dispositions.diagnostic: The merged Scale In preserves the admitted deployment revision. The two disposable installations can reuse the same revision number. The old query included Worker scripts from both installations.
failure_dispositions.correction: Scope the Upgrade receipt queries by installation and revision. Keep cumulative checks for teardown.

failure_dispositions.failure: Replacement workflow missed the 38-second test gate after successful first-attempt Upgrade.
failure_dispositions.diagnostic: The provider logged 15 workflow terminal events across the full run, including one stop. The run did not retain per-route event readback and successor logs to prove why the replacement did not settle in the test window.
failure_dispositions.correction: Target the Managed Upgrade leg and record the successor logs, replacement execution, dispatch, slot, terminal event and ACK before teardown.
failure_dispositions.targeted_result: A clean Managed-only rehearsal with the original intact socket reproduced the exact Upgrade sequence without the initial Existing HTTPS cohort. The successor recorded one replacement dispatch, one completed terminal receipt, one ACK and a released revision-2 slot.
failure_dispositions.historical_root_cause: The first full-run timeout occurred at the settlement readback. The missing route and database evidence prevents attributing its underlying cause.
failure_dispositions.full_sequence_result: The instrumented full rehearsal repeated both installations, the burst, active Scale In, rotation and uninterrupted Upgrade. The replacement settled in 8.368 seconds against the unchanged 38-second check, with one dispatch, one terminal event, one ACK and a released slot.
failure_dispositions.disposition: Did not recur in the targeted or full runs with route and slot evidence. The historical cause remains unresolved.
